name: experiment-mosh-spike-runner

scripts.transpile-async: node jco-transpile.mjs transpile ../async/main.wasm --name async-probe --async-mode jspi --async-wasi-imports --async-wasi-exports --async-imports 'wasi:clocks/monotonic-clock#wait-for' --async-imports 'wasi:clocks/monotonic-clock#wait-until' --async-exports 'experiment:spike/async-probes#sleep-echo' --async-exports 'experiment:spike/async-probes#concurrent-sleeps' --async-exports 'experiment:spike/async-probes#spin-pipeline' --async-exports 'experiment:spike/async-probes#wait-for-echo' --async-exports 'experiment:spike/async-probes#concurrent-wait-fors' --map 'wasi:clocks/monotonic-clock@0.3.0=@bytecodealliance/preview3-shim/clocks#monotonicClock' -o generated-async
